item.title: [ZEPPELIN-1489] Improve JDBC interpreter documentation
item.description:
After https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/1360 merged, Zeppelin doesn't support "mapping from %jdbc(prefix) to %prefix" after 0.7.0 version. Instead, we can use %interpreter_alias as a JDBC interpreter prefix. You can find this information in http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.7.0-SNAPSHOT/install/upgrade.html#upgrading-from-zeppelin-06-to-07.

Actually %jdbc(prefix) itself works at the moment as http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.7.0-SNAPSHOT/interpreter/jdbc.html#multiple-connections describes. But auto-prefix for %jdbc(prefix) doesn't work. After running the paragraph with %jdbc(prefix, newly appended paragraph is not including %jdbc(prefix). It’s quite uncomfortable to type %jdbc(prefix) to every paragraphs’ header. To avoid this inconvenience, we need to use %interpreter_alias for JDBC interpreter prefix. Please see the attached gif image files.

For example, if a user wants to use %hive, he needs to create a new JDBC interpreter(the interpreter name should be “hive” not “jdbc") then set default.driver with hive driver. Currently there is no guide for this in http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.7.0-SNAPSHOT/interpreter/jdbc.html page. Moreover the user wants to connect multiple jdbc drivers(let’s say he needs to connect “mysql” at the same time), he needs to create another JDBC interpreter for Mysql connection. Then he can use %mysql.
So http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.7.0-SNAPSHOT/interpreter/jdbc.html#multiple-connections this page needs to be updated as well.

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: %jdbc interpreter doesn't support %jdbc(prefix) anymore in master branch after https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/1360. I think we need to update docs accordingly to guide user to create separate interpreter for each jdbc and use interpreter alias feature(https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/1145).

Mina Lee
Yeah I agree. In http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.7.0-SNAPSHOT/install/upgrade.html#upgrading-from-zeppelin-06-to-07, it says "Mapping from %jdbc(prefix) to %prefix is no longer available. Instead, you can use %[interpreter alias] with multiple interpreter setttings on GUI." But there is no information where and how I can set "Interpreter alias". I'll take a look this issue and update the issue title accordingly.

To reduce your time of researching, you can use interpreter name as alias. I think it would be nice if you can include this migration notice in jdbc.md page and update all screenshots, configuration not to use prefix.

Mina Lee Yeah that would be better for now. Thanks for suggestion

BTW don't we need to use %jdbc(prefix) if we want to connect to multiple connections with one interpreter? http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.7.0-SNAPSHOT/interpreter/jdbc.html#multiple-connections seems it says so...
What you can do is creating multiple jdbc interpreters with different name. For example, create one jdbc interpreter with name hive and another with mysql.

Mina Lee Yeah I'm using like that for the multiple connection. It's quite confusing. Many other JDBC users might same with me. I think http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.7.0-SNAPSHOT/interpreter/jdbc.html#multiple-connections needs to be update. Thanks Mina for your prompt response!

GitHub user AhyoungRyu opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/1480

ZEPPELIN-1489 Remove jdbc-like interpreter example properties and improve JDBC docs

      1. What is this PR for?
        Currently we can use `%jdbc(prefix)` for multi database connections(e.g. configuring both postgresql and hive in one JDBC interpreter). But after #1360 merged, Zeppelin doesn't support `%jdbc(prefix)` to `%prefix` anymore. So auto-prefix feature is not working for `%jdbc(prefix)`. The auto-prefix only works for `%prefix` now. Considering this status, it would be better we remove the JDBC connection examples in `jdbc/interpreter-setting.json` (this is come from #1096) so that users can create several JDBC interpreters instead of using multiple connections with one JDBC interpreter. I removed the related contents in `jdbc.md` as well.

Also, the contents of [current JDBC documentation page](http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.7.0-SNAPSHOT/interpreter/jdbc.html) is quite confusing and unorganized. So I updated the contents with some screenshot images to guide "How to create JDBC interpreter", "How to edit the interpreter properties for the connection", "How to use `%prefix` with the interpreter", and so on.

      1. What type of PR is it?
        Improvement & Documentation
      1. What is the Jira issue?
  • ZEPPELIN-1489(https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZEPPELIN-1489)
      1. How should this be tested?
  • Removing example properties in `interpreter-setting.json`
    1. after applying this patch and build with `mvn clean package -DskipTests -Pspark-1.6 -pl 'jdbc,zeppelin-interpreter,zeppelin-web,zeppelin-server,zeppelin-zengine,zeppelin-display`
    2. create JDBC interpreter and check whether the example settings are gone or not
  • JDBC docs
    1. Build only `docs/` dir as described in [here](https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/blob/master/docs/README.md#build-documentation)
    2. Go to `interpreter -> JDBC` and just compare this locally builded page with [the original JDBC page](https://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.7.0-SNAPSHOT/interpreter/jdbc.html)
